key_decisions.after: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared, and a light shone in the cell. The angel struck Peter on the side and woke him, saying, “Get up quickly!” The chains fell from his hands.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by, and a light shone in the cell; and striking Peter on the side, he raised him, saying, “Rise quickly.” And his chains fell off from his hands.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves realization, certainty, divine mission, rescue, Herod, and public expectation.

key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when Peter came to himself, he said, “Now I know truly that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from the hand of Herod and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.”
